notes.title: CONTRA SPEM SPERO — OUT NOW!
notes.content:
You find yourself in a place you never imagined could exist — one that remembers every decision you’ve tried to forget.

Was your fate sealed the moment you stepped into the forest’s trap? Were these creatures truly once human? You can only hope you won’t share their fate. Because everything — and everyone — tells you this time, you won’t leave.

[previewyoutube=yuKXvSuda6g;full][/previewyoutube]

 70,000+ words — choose a story that will stay on these pages forever.
 4 endings — which one reveals the truth?
 4+ hours per playthrough — with branching paths and hidden quests, completionists can expect 8+ hours of unique content across multiple playthroughs.
 55 unique locations — the deeper you go, the stranger it gets.
 Creatures — they are everywhere. Watching, waiting..

To survive, you’ll need to listen. To understand.
Unravel their past. Accept your own.
Choose a side.

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302261/a98795abebcb0d37a0b76b48ab448b22eb654f2c.png

To everyone who wishlisted, shared, or rooted for us — thank you!
This release wouldn’t have been possible without your support. It’s been incredible to see such a kind and curious community grow around this surreal little world.

We hope this is only the beginning. We have so many stories left to tell — and we can’t wait to share them with you.

If you enjoyed the journey, please consider leaving a Steam review. Every bit of feedback helps us improve — and helps more players discover the game!


Brought to you by DADZINGO, the ones still searching for a way out.

notes.title: CONTRA SPEM SPERO RELEASES AUGUST 14
notes.content:
Contra Spem Spero is finally coming out on August 14 — the very day everything changed.


Trapped in an endless night, surrounded by things you can’t explain and creatures that were once human, you’re left with few choices. Listen to them.. and maybe you’ll find a way out.



Whether it’s another lost man, a desperate creature, a wandering observer, a mysterious entity, or someone indescribable — each carries a past that can shape your future. What future will you decide to embrace?

And what future do you truly deserve? 


It won’t be long before the answer becomes clear.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302261/a98c9c697a1af5e93579bcf7fd33ffd77861e7b0.png"]

Stay connected with us for more on the road to release. After all, one can never have too many souls, right? Go get ‘em already!



Strolling through the forest’s labyrinth,

notes.title: THE WAIT IS ALMOST OVER
notes.content:
At the beginning of next month, the wait will finally end! Keep your eyes open — the launch date will be announced August 1st.


What awaits in the full release?

All existing locations to explore and revisit

Routes to choose from

More characters to meet

Various new dialogue themes

Solvable puzzles in all their layered glory

Even more opportunities to make questionable life-and-death decisions

And, of course, so much more.


Remember what you’re here for..
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302261/366c8cb93ced5b43a1b3138daf6e63238bd395ee.png"]

Until the next page turns,

DADZINGO
